summary.en: The claim as a general arrangement: a two-line headline, then input → system → output as three boxes on one axis with arrows, the system name large in the middle, an overall dimension under them.
summary.zh: 把主张画成总体布置图：两行标题，然后是同一轴线上的“输入 → 系统 → 输出”三个方框和箭头，系统名在中间放大，下方一条总尺寸线。

fits: The claim of a system film: what goes in, what the product is, what comes out.
notFor: Claims with branches or more than one product; names longer than 14 characters.

intent.en: Show the product as one designed part between an input and an output, dimensioned like a real assembly.
intent.zh: 把产品画成输入与输出之间的一个被设计的部件，像真正的装配图一样标尺寸。

content.en: Label, two lines (≤ 18 chars), a sub (≤ 6 words), input, system and output each a tag and a name.
content.zh: 标签、两行（每行 ≤ 8 字）、一句副标题、输入/系统/输出各一个标签和名称。

fits.zh: 系统类片子的主张：进去什么、产品是什么、出来什么。

notFor.zh: 有分支或多个产品的主张；超过 6 字的名称。

en: Three names must leave 110 px between boxes; long names fail before they shrink.
zh: 三个名称之间要留出 110 px；名称太长会直接放不下。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
